# laravel_cloud_environments (Data Source)

Lists an application's environments, optionally filtered by name, slug and status. Use it to reference an environment that is not managed in this configuration, such as one created in the dashboard, a preview environment, or one managed by another Terraform workspace.

~> **Beta:** This provider is in beta and may change between releases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laravel_cloud_applications" "shop" {
  slug = "shop"
}

# Filters match as substrings, so pick the exact match out of the list.
data "laravel_cloud_environments" "staging" {
  application_id = one([for a in data.laravel_cloud_applications.shop.applications : a.id if a.slug == "shop"])
  name           = "staging"
}

# Attach a domain to an environment managed outside this configuration.
resource "laravel_cloud_domain" "staging" {
  environment_id = one([for e in data.laravel_cloud_environments.staging.environments : e.id if e.name == "staging"])
  name           = "staging.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) ID of the application whose environments to list.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only list environments whose name contains this value. The API matches it as a substring.
- `slug` (String) Only list environments whose slug contains this value. The API matches it as a substring.
- `status` (String) Only list environments whose status contains this value, such as `running` or `stopped`. The API matches it as a substring.

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) Matching environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source: the application ID.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the dedicated cluster the environment runs on; null on shared compute.
- `created_at` (String) When the environment was created.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the dashboard: the name, or a preview environment's pull request title.
- `framework` (String) Framework Laravel Cloud detected in the branch (such as laravel, nextjs).
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `language` (String) Language of the environment (such as php, javascript).
- `name` (String) Environment name.
- `node_version` (String) Node.js version.
- `php_major_version` (String) Major PHP version (such as "8.4").
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly slug.
- `status` (String) Current environment status.
- `uses_push_to_deploy` (Boolean) Whether a push to the environment's branch deploys it.
- `vanity_hostname` (String) Full vanity domain hostname, such as "my-app.laravel.cloud". Null when there is none.
